pairs.fix: Draw the candelabra much larger, so the base nearly reaches the bottom edge and the flames nearly reach the top edge. Widen the arms so the candles sit close to the left and right edges. Fill most of the card with the object and leave no large empty background areas.

pattern: Generated cards hold the hero back. The whole object fits inside the card, small and centered, with even empty space on every side. The real cards push the hero big and close: it fills the card, nearly touches the edges, and is sometimes cut off by one. Generated cards also add extra props or decorative background icons that compete with the hero at thumbnail size.
